create_file_prediction_provider: create a FilePredictionProvider instance to load prediction files from a directory in DOCTAGS, JSON, YAML, or MARKDOWN format
run_file_prediction_provider_predict: run the FilePredictionProvider predict method to generate a prediction from a dataset record by reading the corresponding file
build_file_prediction_provider_info: build a FilePredictionProvider and call info to retrieve supported formats, current format, and source path
test_file_prediction_provider_doctags: test loading a DOCTAGS prediction file with optional page image support using FilePredictionProvider
test_file_prediction_provider_json: test loading a JSON prediction file with optional missing-file handling using FilePredictionProvider
